# Collected notes

A limit describes the value a function approaches as the input approaches a point. The value at the point itself can differ from the limit.

The grape boycott was a labor campaign connected with farmworker organizing. It used consumer pressure to support agricultural workers.

# Sampling

The variance of a sum equals the sum of the component variances.

However, this shortcut assumes independent components. Otherwise the covariance terms must also be included.

A bar chart represents categories with separate bars. It differs from a histogram, whose bins represent numerical intervals.

documents.text:
# Linear maps

Theorem. The map T(x)=2x is linear.

Proof. For any vectors u and v, T(u+v)=2(u+v)=2u+2v=T(u)+T(v).

For a scalar c, T(cu)=2cu=c(2u)=cT(u). Both required properties hold. QED

Length preservation is not a requirement for linearity. This map doubles vector lengths.

checks.query: Prove that multiplying a vector by two is linear.
